independent.summary: The ✕ button calls removeQuestion() and issues DELETE /open-questions/:id on a single click with no confirmation, and this collection has no ChangeLog trail or rollback (stated in the docs/api.md rows added by this same diff), so a mis-click permanently destroys a question; every other destructive action in this client confirms first (EntityDetail.vue:284 'Delete "x"? This cannot be undone.', RelationshipsSection.vue:449, PasskeySettings inline confirm).

The re-seed watcher fires on any incoming entity object — WikiLayout.vue:1012 replaces selectedEntity wholesale on every SSE entity:updated — and unconditionally clears newQuestion, editingId/editText, pendingId and addPending, so a concurrent edit by another client (or an MCP write) discards text typed into the add field or the open inline editor and re-enables a row's controls while its PUT/POST is still in flight, allowing a second conflicting write whose late response then appends or replaces a row in the freshly re-seeded list.

The module sends X-SSE-Client-Id on every unsafe method "so the live-sync stream can tell this tab's own writes from another's", but no /open-questions handler broadcasts anything (unlike entities.js:283/313/351, tags.js:100, changelog.js:270), so the header is inert and a second tab viewing the same entity keeps rendering a question that was deleted or renamed — and keeps the stale open-count badge — until something else forces a refetch.

grades.reason: removeQuestion() in EntityHeader.vue wraps deleteOpenQuestion in try/catch and surfaces the server's message through failed()/questionError, and the cited file is only 118 lines long so line 150 does not exist.
The question text is rendered with Vue mustache interpolation ({{ oq.question }}), which HTML-escapes; there is no v-html anywhere in the new markup, so no XSS vector exists.
asRow reads properties off the returned object — missing fields yield undefined rather than throwing — and every route returns the full OpenQuestion document, so the described crash cannot occur.

Exactly backwards: the single server change in this diff adds `runValidators: true` to the PUT findOneAndUpdate (openQuestions.js:205) so `{status:'banana'}` is now a 400 VALIDATION_FAILED, and line 215 is the DELETE handler, not the update.

triageGrades.reason: The change adds a new credentialed write surface plus a canWrite permission gate on the controls, and its new server suite exercises unauthenticated 401 and cross-workspace 404/entry_ids-dropping isolation.
No credentials, tokens, or env secrets appear anywhere in the diff.
Nothing touches billing, quotas, or the AI allowance — open questions are free CRUD.
The diff adds a browser-reachable DELETE /open-questions/:id path (api module plus the ✕ button), which is genuinely destructive.
All calls are to this app's own Express routes; no third-party service is contacted.
No build, deploy, migration, or version/config changes — only client code, a server one-liner, tests, and docs.

summary: All four findings are false positives — including one that asserts the absence of the very `runValidators: true` fix this diff adds — and the local review missed the unconfirmed irreversible delete and the re-seed watcher's clobbering of in-flight state, while its triage read was entirely right.
